citation.theorem_number: Classification theorem, Part I: the five-point planar two-distance set is the regular pentagon.
citation.verbatim: FLAG: verbatim transcription of the classification sentence from the printed Indagationes text (pp. 479–488) is to be supplied at the human side-by-side check before stamping; the machine record deliberately holds a placeholder rather than an invented quotation.

claim: Conditional on the declared axiom (Einhorn–Schoenberg 1966): every 5-point planar set with at most two mutual distances is a regular pentagon. This certifies the n=5 fragment of lemma L1 (D(5)=2 attained, regular pentagon the unique minimizer up to similarity); covers=fragment and does NOT close close_branch_A, which quantifies over all sufficiently large n.
